page.overview:
What is My Apocalypse?

My Apocalypse is the final track on Metallica's ninth studio album, Death Magnetic, and the forty-first single by the band. The song could be considered a look back to songs like "Damage, Inc." or "Dyers Eve", being a short (5:01) and high tempo ending to an album, just like on Master of Puppets and ...And Justice For All.

"My Apocalypse" is about a brutal car wreck. "Crushing metal, ripping skin, tossing body, mannequin, spilling blood, bleeding gas", very much describes a car crash.

Claustrophobic Crawl out of this skin Heart explosive Reach in, pull that pin

Fear thy name: extermination Desecrate inhale the fire
